understanding.purpose: 展示审批流水，供读者查看各申请的金额、状态与审批意见。
understanding.reading: 读者可先按单号定位记录，再横向核对申请人、类型、金额和状态；比较状态或金额时也会纵向扫读。较长的审批意见可以分行，并利用该行因其他内容换行产生的高度。
groups: 单号、申请人和类型共同标识一笔申请及其背景。
金额和状态是便于逐行比较的关键字段。
状态与审批意见共同说明审批进展，意见对状态提供补充。
keep_intact: 单号及金额数值，包括金额中的逗号和小数。
申请人姓名和状态词应尽量保持完整。
may_wrap: 审批意见可按语义自然换行。
申请类型可在空间紧张时换行。

bad.why: The type and status columns are reduced to one character per line, making repeated values difficult to scan and leaving much of each tall row empty.
The opinion column becomes an almost single-character vertical strip, splitting a word and stretching the longest row so far that it is difficult to read as a unit.
The type and status values run one character per line throughout, weakening comparison across the table despite the wider opinion column.
The type and status values run one character per line throughout, while the extra width given to applicant names does little to improve their presentation.
Type and status values run one character per line, and the narrow opinion column also creates a very tall long-comment row.

final.rationale: r2A keeps amounts intact and gives the opinion column enough room to make the long approval comment substantially easier to read. Its type values retain two-character groupings, helping readers distinguish repeated entries across rows. The narrow applicant and status columns still produce vertical text, but that is a considered compromise within the phone viewport.

general: Protect the width needed for numbers and identifiers that must be compared or recognized reliably.
Allocate width to columns according to their content and reading role; long prose can need more space than repeated short values.
Judge wrapping across the whole row: a single narrow prose column can create large empty areas in every other cell.
specific: The 92px amount column accommodates the widest amount, while the 77px opinion column gives the long comment useful line lengths.
At 53px the type column retains two-character groupings; reducing it to 51px produces noticeably more vertical text.

final.tradeoffs: r1B gives status values a more readable two-character measure and leaves more headers on one line, but its narrower opinion column makes the longest comment much taller. r2B improves applicant names at the same cost to opinion width.
final.uncertain: The ranges are conservative visual estimates around r2A, not independently rendered or verified thresholds. They describe individual width adjustments with the remaining columns rebalanced proportionally within the 359px limit; simultaneous changes can cross wrapping thresholds. A designer who prioritizes scanning status over reading comments might prefer r1B.

A.why: 单号和金额都被拆行，金额的小数部分与整数分离；审批意见也被挤成很窄的竖列，难以比较。

B.why: 单号和金额完整，但申请人、类型和状态几乎逐字竖排，审批意见也很狭窄，横向读行费力。

C.why: 金额完整、类型尚可辨读，但单号被拆开，申请人和审批意见过窄，长意见造成大面积空白。

D.why: 金额完整，审批意见获得较多空间而易于阅读；但单号拆行，申请人、类型和状态多为逐字竖排，削弱了逐行扫描。

E.why: 申请人和类型较易辨读，金额完整；但单号拆行，状态逐字竖排，长审批意见仍被挤成窄列。

F.why: 金额完整，类型按词组分行，审批意见比多数方案易读；但单号拆行，申请人和状态列过窄。

reviews.unsure: D 的审批意见更易阅读；如果长意见比类型更重要，D 也可能是较好的选择。所有方案都存在明显的窄列折行。

A.why: 金额完整且类型按词组分行，审批意见也有一定阅读宽度；但单号断开，姓名和状态逐字竖排，扫描较费力。

B.why: 金额完整，状态比 A 稍易读，但单号断开、姓名竖排，狭窄的意见栏使长意见和对应行过分拉长。

C.why: 单号和金额完整，便于识别与比较；但类型、状态和意见都很窄，长意见形成密集的竖排文字，行间空白失衡。

D.why: 金额在逗号和小数部分随意断行，严重妨碍数值比较；单号也断开，长意见仍被挤成窄列。

E.why: 金额完整，意见栏较宽，长意见能以较自然的短句阅读，行高也较均衡；代价是单号断开，类型和状态逐字竖排。

F.why: 金额完整，姓名和类型比多数方案易读；但单号断开，状态逐字竖排，意见栏过窄使长意见及其所在行很长。

reviews.unsure: E 的类型和状态竖排较难扫描；若读者主要按单号查找，C 保留完整单号的优势可能更重要，但其意见栏更难读。
